Hockrow Agency
Case File #BR74382
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor
Case Summary:
A known outlaw attacked and destroyed a ship near [LOCATION]. The agency has been contracted to retrieve the ship’s blackbox in order to build a case against them and lobby for Advocacy intervention.
Contract Investigator Actions:
An operative is needed to head to the crime scene at [LOCATION], secure the area from any hostiles present to procure the blackbox, and deliver to [DESTINATION].
Additional Notes:
Be advised that there are still hostile forces in the area that will attack. These will most likely have some experience fighting, so be prepared.
This contract has been flagged as a combat mission.

Heyo,
Over at [LOCATION] we just got a refueling job for an entire small fleet of ships who all together need [FUELTYPE]. Talk about when it rains it pours!
The client will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
Unfortunately, where they're held up isn't the nicest of sectors so I'd be alert for any tomfoolery while you're doing the run.
It'll be best to try get them all back on their way as soon as you can.
Happy trails,
Dina Deloit

United Wayfarers Club

LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION] Many of these ores are extremely rare and difficult to find, detectable only when a rock has been cracked open.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].

19ffu4a.description_en:
Crew managing one of our client's operations at [LOCATION] have reported that they're under attack from a criminal gang targeting the [OBJECTS] and ships in the area. It will be your job to keep both safe at all costs. I don't have all the facts yet, but I reckon this will be a tough mission – these outlaws seem determined to do some real carnage.
If it were me, I would <EM>bring backup</EM4> to deal with them. And if you manage to protect everyone, we’re offering a well-earned 4 MG Scrip to the main contractor who deals with these lowlife's successfully.
Best of luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
19ffu4a.description_zh:
我们一位客户在 [LOCATION] 的运营团队报告称，他们正遭到一个犯罪团伙的攻击，对方企图掠夺该区域的 [OBJECTS] 和飞船。你的任务是不惜一切代价确保双方安全。我目前尚未掌握全部事实，但我认为这将是一场艰难的任务，这些不法分子似乎决心要大肆屠杀。

如果换作是我，我会带上增援来对付他们。如果你能成功保护所有人，我们将向成功解决这群下等人的主承包商支付一份应得的 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证作为奖励。

祝你好运，

尤金·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保
“安全，尽在掌握”

福克斯韦尔安保是一家获得 UEE 全境执业许可的担保安全专家公司。我们始终欢迎新的干员加入我们的大家庭。如果您或您认识的任何人对此感兴趣，请与我们的合约代表联系。

CONTRACT: Manufacturing Order
LOCATION: Nyx
DETAILS:
If you happen to have any other work bringing you to one of the QV Breaker Stations in the Keeger Belt, Shubin Interstellar would be highly interested in contracting you to obtaining a supply of hard-to-source mining laser focus lenses.
TERMS*:
While there may be some focus lenses that can be recovered from the QV Breaker Station's storage, you must likely will need to manufacture them using Sadaryx crystals and the on-site lens fabricator. While the ore is rare, these Breaker Stations typically have sadaryx veins that can be mined directly with a Multi-Tool with a Mining Attachment.
Deliver the procured lenses to the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION] for processing.
Contractors have reported that these stations may have been infiltrated by outlaws, so caution is advised.
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
